description: Committee recommends terminating Maven's business incentive.
Committee recommends new agreement with Integrated Sustainability.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Administration confirmed this is the first time a BDI recipient failed to meet FTEs.
Taxpayers could be affected if $54,000 is not recovered.
Administration recommended no recovery of prior amounts, but committee recommended recovery.
Councillors raised concerns about setting a precedent for not meeting incentive criteria.
Administration noted potential legal complexities if funds are not willingly repaid.
Integrated Sustainability committed to growing their Saskatoon business and hiring more staff.
